stations.title: Bridie
stations.note: She chalks the board by hand.

stations.title: Ossian
stations.say: Fog on the river. Not today.
stations.note: He calls it off from the boat.

stations.title: Departures board
stations.text: Shows what Ossian decided, every crossing.

captions: The departures board at the hut. Bridie has to say whether the next crossing goes.
Today she chalks it by hand, and it said boarding while Ossian had called it off.
You write the true or false answers and the decisions, in four small tasks.
Now the board follows the wind, the fog and the seats, and each fare is right.
Booleans and if. The clipboard's last job is done by the program.
